name: BlockQuarry Corp.
summary: Operating across North America, BlockQuarry Corp. delivers specialized mining and hosting solutions within the digital currency industry. The company utilizes a blockchain framework to convert distinct, identifiable assets into fungible digital assets, including popular options like Bitcoin. Formerly known as ISW Holdings Inc., the firm rebranded to BlockQuarry Corp. in August 2021 and maintains its principal office in Reno, Nevada.
